effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When effects add digivolution cards under any of your Digimon with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits, by suspending this Tamer, one of those Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
